title: Digital Fortress
author: Dan Brown
summary: The National Security Agency's giant code-breaking machine meets an unbreakable code. A cryptographer and her fiance, a linguist sent to Spain, race against time to find a key before the secrets of the agency are exposed.
readIf: you want a short, quick, techno thriller from before the author's biggest success.
skipIf: you want technical realism; the computing details are very dated and often unlikely.

pairings.reason: A much wittier, stranger look at hackers, code and power, set in a lively near-future.
Another fast thriller about an ordinary professional who learns that a respectable organisation is hiding something sinister.
A more detailed, technical thriller with plenty of high-stakes manoeuvring.
